title: Uncertainty and Influence aware Reward Model Refinement for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

contributions.purpose: 解决 RLHF 中固定 reward model 的 off-distribution 与过优化问题：策略优化持续改变数据分布使代理奖励模型退化，而重新采集人类偏好数据代价高。
contributions.mechanism: 提出 UGDA（Uncertainty-Gradient based Data Augmentation），复用策略交互样本、经专家重标注后用监督学习精炼奖励模型，从而保持 on-distribution，无需昂贵人类偏好数据。
contributions.evaluation: 在 Anthropic HH 数据集、Gemma-2B/7B 奖励模型 + Gemma-7B 策略上，用 Llama2-13B 与 GPT-4 评审，UGDA 在 AvgReward、AlpacaEval/Arena-Hard/MT-Bench 上超过 SFT/PPO/LCB/UWO/RLR 全部基线。
contributions.source_quote: We design a novel method to collect the high quality data for reward model refining to solve the off-distribution reward overoptmization problem.

contributions.purpose: 为奖励模型提供不确定性估计并支撑交互数据的收集。
contributions.mechanism: 训练奖励模型的 LoRA ensembles，用集成输出的均值优化策略、方差作为不确定性度量，并收集策略训练期的交互样本。
contributions.evaluation: 定性/结构性贡献；集成的方差用于后续 uncertainty-based 数据选择，均值用于 PPO 策略优化（Eq. 8）。
contributions.source_quote: We leverage the ensembles for the reward model uncertainty estimation and interaction data collection.

contributions.purpose: 从大量交互样本中挑出对奖励模型精炼最有价值的高质量数据。
contributions.mechanism: 设计 uncertainty-gradient 联合数据选择：先按奖励方差（不确定性）选，再用基于 Adam 梯度的 influence score（随机投影降维，保 J-L 内积）选出对策略优化有影响的样本。
contributions.evaluation: 消融实验（Figure 4）显示 uncertainty 与 gradient 两支联合选择均有贡献；投影维度 1024–8192 的超参分析中高维通常更优。
contributions.source_quote: We design an uncertainty-gradient based data selection for reward model refining, which can select the data with high uncertainty and be influential for the policy optimization.

contributions.purpose: 实证验证 UGDA 相对现有 SOTA 基线的有效性与鲁棒性。
contributions.mechanism: 在策略与奖励模型两个层面评测：AvgReward/VarReward、GPT-4 win/tie/lose、指令跟随基准、RewardBench、鲁棒性（20% 翻转噪声）。
contributions.evaluation: UGDA reward model 在 helpful/harmless 测试集上 Gemma-2B 达 69.3%/68.5%、Gemma-7B 达 72.1%/71.2% 准确率；多数基线低于随机猜测（仅 RLR 例外）；噪声设定下 UGDA 性能下降最小。
contributions.source_quote: We conduct experiments to show the effectiveness of our UGDA, the results show that our UGDA can improve the performance compared with many state-of-the-art baselines.

self_declared_provenance.quote: some works focus on modeling reward uncertainty using ensembles (Coste et al., 2023; Eisenstein et al., 2023; Lang et al., 2024) ... Different from the above approaches, our method focuses on the on-distribution reward modeling data augmentation, aiming to refine the reward model's distribution in conjunction with policy optimization.

Xia et al. (2024) select data for the SFT by calculating the gradient features. Our method selects data by the gradient information, which is similar to (Mirzasoleiman et al., 2020; Killamsetty et al., 2021; Han et al., 2023; Xia et al., 2024). Different from the above works, we focus on select the on-distribution data generated by the optimization procedure of the policy, rather than select the offline training dataset.
motivated by (Coste et al., 2023), we propose to learn the LoRA ensembles of the reward model ... Adam Influence (Xia et al., 2024)

notes: 方法叠加型工作，明确嫁接 Coste et al. 2023 的 reward ensemble 与 Xia et al. 2024 的 Adam-influence 梯度选择。注意 caveat：作者自陈局限——实验仅在 Anthropic HH 单一数据集、仅 helpful/harmless 两个设定，超参分析受算力限制；且报告 reward 与 perplexity 之间存在 trade-off（第 843 行：higher rewards vs lower perplexity 的取舍）。RewardBench 上除 Reasoning 维度外 UGDA 优于基线（Reasoning 因过滤后交互数据里该类样本少而落后）。
